scripts.test:proxy-network: bun -e "if (!Bun.env.PROXY_PROBE_TEST_BINARY) { console.error('PROXY_PROBE_TEST_BINARY is required'); process.exit(1) }" && bun test --timeout 120000 src/modules/proxies/transport.network.test.ts
scripts.test:postgres: bun -e "const url=Bun.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL; if (!url) { console.error('TEST_DATABASE_URL is required and must target tk_mg_test_*'); process.exit(1) } if (!new URL(url).pathname.slice(1).startsWith('tk_mg_test_')) { console.error('TEST_DATABASE_URL must target tk_mg_test_*'); process.exit(1) }" && bun test --timeout 120000 --max-concurrency 1 src
scripts.test:deployment-postgres: bun -e "const url=Bun.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL; if (!url) { console.error('TEST_DATABASE_URL is required and must target tk_mg_test_*'); process.exit(1) } if (!new URL(url).pathname.slice(1).startsWith('tk_mg_test_')) { console.error('TEST_DATABASE_URL must target tk_mg_test_*'); process.exit(1) }" && bun test --timeout 120000 --max-concurrency 1 src/bootstrap-deployment.postgres.test.ts
